title: Dependency Upgrades, Dependabot, JSDoc and Clean-Code Rules
summary: Upgrade every npm package to its latest stable version with the store's behaviour unchanged, set up Dependabot for version and security updates, document every source file and export with JSDoc (checked by npm run check), and write coding standards with the design patterns this repo uses.

acceptanceCriteria.text: npm outdated (root, workspaces, spec dashboard) shows nothing behind latest stable, except agreed and listed exceptions.
Deprecated @types/ioredis and @types/uuid removed; no declared library (or its @types) installed in two majors; upstream-pinned transitive duplicates listed, not overridden.
npm run check and npm run build pass; unit tests ≥ 237; tests changed for an upgrade listed with reasons.
Every service image rebuilds from clean; 10/10 health checks healthy.
End to end as before: pre-upgrade user signs in, register, products, cart, order CONFIRMED/CANCELLED, assistant turn (ratings checked by 012).
Gateway protections unchanged: 401 without JWT, 429 on the 101st request in 15 min, 502 within the timeout with a service stopped, recovery after (no circuit breaker exists; P1).
Storefront builds with new React, router and Vite; all 6 pages load with no console errors.
.github/dependabot.yml covers npm (root, spec dashboard) and Docker, weekly, grouped minor/patch, majors separate; GitHub shows no config errors.
Docs describe reviewing a Dependabot PR locally without CI.
Every non-test source file has a header comment and every export a JSDoc block (today 87/124 files and 151/317 exports lack them; after: 0 and 0).
npm run check fails on a missing header or export JSDoc, naming file and line; the checker is unit-tested.
Coding-standards doc with patterns and clean-code rules, each with a repo example; referenced by the constitution (version bump), CLAUDE.md and the workflow.
Records updated: tech-stack versions, one decision per major upgrade (D-029 superseded), learnings, roadmap backlog.
